name: Gutwall Syndicate
description: The Gutwall Syndicate emerged in 2210 from the GUTPUNCH underground reflex circuit, operating out of rotating venues in the Tier 1-2 border zone known as the Seam. Unlike most stables, Gutwall specializes entirely in BCI-integrated reflex combat — fighters whose augmentation is almost entirely neural, with minimal external chrome, making matches appear almost mundanely human until a fighter moves at three times baseline speed and redirects kinetic force through precision nerve-wire.
story_hooks: A Gutwall fighter realizes mid-season that their reflex augmentation was installed without their full informed consent during what they were told was a routine BCI calibration.
Someone is distributing NEUROVORE combat mods through Gutwall's supply chain — the Syndicate doesn't know, but the enforcement divisions are about to come down hard.
A Tier 4 corponation exec has been attending Gutwall matches in disguise for months; their interest is not recreational.
